name: Zapier
description: Zapier's hosted server exposes the actions you enable in Zapier — Gmail, Slack, HubSpot and thousands more — as tools the agent can call.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (mcp.zapier.com) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
